_comment: Where /sync-doc last left off. One entry per build repo.
`lastSyncedSha` is the commit on that repo's `dev` branch that the spec
site was last reconciled against. null = never synced, so the next run
does a FULL inventory comparison instead of a commit diff.
Only /sync-doc writes this file, and only after the user approves the
doc edits — a rejected proposal must leave the baseline untouched, or the
changes it found would be silently skipped forever.
